title: Stamped verdict with freshness provenance (IMP-0095)
description: A stored quality score, vulnerability verdict, or conformance result carrying the timestamp and input hashes it was computed from. A green result computed last week against a live advisory database is not a control for today.

result.description: The stored outcome, e.g. CLEAN/PASS or a score_bp integer.

computed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the verdict was computed.

input_hashes.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON encoding of each hashable input.

unhashable_inputs.description: Live inputs (e.g. advisory_db) that are listed because they cannot be hashed; they decay via the age signal.

freshness_window_seconds.description: Age beyond this window marks the verdict STALE even when no input hash changed.
